$comment: Records the IndexedDB format numbers of the current Electron version, so CI can tell when
bumping Electron would introduce a downgrade floor. Regenerate with `pnpm idb:baseline`.
Any increase to a version number below means users who take that build can never roll back
past it without losing every Element database for the vector://vector origin, including the

currentFloor.$comment: Oldest Element Desktop release the current format era can be downgraded to.
currentFloor.since: Electron 43 / Chromium 150 raised v8SerializerVersion from 15 to 16
